description: Every surjective function has a right inverse obtained by selecting a preimage of each target point, under the default Choice convention.
signature:
Function.rightInverse_surjInv.{u, v} {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} {f : α → β} (hf : Function.Surjective f) :
  Function.RightInverse (Function.surjInv hf) f
